title: Personalize Experience Not Rendering for Returning Visitors
alternate_search_terms: Personalize not working for returning visitors
Personalize experience only renders on first visit

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's Personalize experience rendered correctly for first-time visitors but not returning visitors on the same device.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The site blocked third-party cookies by default, causing the Personalize identity-resolution cookie to be dropped between sessions.
resolution_steps: Updated the cookie-consent configuration to allow the Personalize first-party cookie category by default
